# ask-widget docs

Install, configure and integrate the streaming React chat widget.

- [Introduction](/index.md): Add ask-widget to a React application, connect your own backend and customize the interface.
- [API reference](/api.md): Source-generated ChatWidget props, response adapters and customization options.
- [Architecture](/architecture.md): Understand the React components, streaming adapter and browser-local persistence.
- [Connect a streaming chat backend](/backend.md): Connect your React chat widget to an SSE endpoint or custom response handler while keeping provider credentials on your server.
- [Changelog](/changelog.md): Find published ask-widget release notes and package changes.
- [Development](/development.md): Run the library, Next.js website and independent Monoline documentation locally.
- [Install the React chat widget](/getting-started.md): Install ask-widget, add its stylesheet and connect a React chat interface to your own streaming backend.
- [Standalone hooks](/hooks.md): Build a custom React chat interface with chat, SSE and persistence hooks.
- [React chat integration for Next.js and Vite](/integrations.md): Add ask-widget to Next.js App Router or Vite with the correct client boundary, stylesheet imports and backend configuration.
- [Maintenance and releases](/maintenance.md): Prepare npm and JSR releases, publish verified tags and recover one failed destination.
- [Customize chat widget themes](/theming.md): Style ask-widget with light and dark presets, CSS variables and custom colors that match your React website.
- [Troubleshooting](/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose stylesheet, streaming, persistence and backend integration problems.
